entity.summary: Iranian centralized cryptocurrency exchange offering account-based crypto trading, easy-buy and professional trading interfaces, custody, P2P markets, staking and mobile access. The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Bitpin on June 2, 2026 pursuant to Executive Order 13902 for operating in Iran's financial sector; the current first-party platform remains publicly operational.
entity.notes: The current first-party site explicitly describes Bitpin as a centralized exchange and exposes registration, KYC, rial and crypto funding, professional trading, easy purchase, P2P and staking functions. Treasury identifies Bitpin as an Iranian digital-asset exchange and designated it under E.O. 13902 on 2026-06-02. The designation is a material regulatory event but does not establish an operational shutdown, so HEI retains active status. No exact launch date is asserted from the reviewed sources.

events.title: U.S. Treasury designated Bitpin under Iran sanctions authority
events.description: The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control designated Bitpin pursuant to Executive Order 13902 for operating in the financial sector of the Iranian economy.
events.notes: Treasury also described Bitpin as an Iranian digital-asset exchange and reported activity linked to sanctioned actors. HEI records the designation without inferring a shutdown because the reviewed first-party platform remained operational in August 2026.
